# Context menu

A menu of actions on right-click or long-press.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Right-click menus suit power users. Readers are occasional visitors who see the interface fresh each time, and arrive on phones too. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./button">Button</a></span></p>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Power users acting on an item in place, with the same actions also reachable elsewhere.
- **Not when:** The only way to reach an action: people who don't know to right-click never find it.

Instead:

- [Dropdown menu](./dropdown-menu.md): The same actions from a visible button.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Shift F10 or the menu key opens it; arrows move; Escape closes. | undefined |



## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add context-menu
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
